CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Calming the Storm? (1 mark)
   A. Use Calming the Storm to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Calming the Storm with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Calming the Storm.
   D. Say Calming the Storm has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi.
   B. Say The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of God’s Plan for Redemption? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of God’s Plan for Redemption with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use God’s Plan for Redemption to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say God’s Plan for Redemption has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God’s Plan for Redemption.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Holy Spirit to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit.
   C. Say The Holy Spirit has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Teachings on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Teachings on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Teachings on Prayer has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings on Prayer.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Origin and Consequences of Sin? (1 mark)
   A. Use Origin and Consequences of Sin to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Origin and Consequences of Sin with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Origin and Consequences of Sin has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Origin and Consequences of Sin.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

10. Which response best shows understanding of Abrahamic Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Say Abrahamic Covenant has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Abrahamic Covenant.
   C. Use Abrahamic Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Abrahamic Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of the Paralytic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Healing of the Paralytic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Healing of the Paralytic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Healing of the Paralytic has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of the Paralytic.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5.
   D. Use Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel: Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Leadership in Israel: Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel: Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Leadership in Israel: Saul has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel: Saul.

14. Which response best shows understanding of The Lost Sheep? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Lost Sheep.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Lost Sheep with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Lost Sheep to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Lost Sheep has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Faith and God’s Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Say Faith and God’s Promises has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Faith and God’s Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith and God’s Promises.
   D. Apply the teaching of Faith and God’s Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership in Israel: Saul and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Calming the Storm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Healing of the Paralytic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Spirit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
